prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for adoption (new_screen, redesign), home (new_flow), and choose_path (reorder) changes because only one test has been completed for each.
Evidence is still thin for finish (new_screen) changes because the two completed tests disagreed after noise correction (+7.8% vs -6.3%).
Reordering sign_in steps was helpful overall, backed by 3 positive noise-corrected tests including 1 win (+8.1%), though no clear effect was seen in the other 2 tests.
Predictions were generally too high across most tests, but were too low for the round 8 sign_in reorder test.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_screen: -2.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: +0.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, reorder: -2.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -0.3% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- home, new_flow: -8.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +3.4% after noise correction, 3 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 82.2%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 77.0%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 23.9%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Pet Choice Split Comparison Stage: Redesign the pet choice screen using a split layout to clearly present pre-made companion selection versus custom generation side-by-side. (why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate at 60.9% and a long mean duration of 1017s, indicating visual hesitation and confusion during adoption.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Post Companion Selection Sign-In Reorder: Move sign-in directly after companion selection so users pick their pet before creating or logging into an account. (why: Reordering sign-in steps previously yielded positive noise-corrected results (+8.1%), and asking for sign-in after picking a companion increases user intent.)
2: [home, new_screen] Desktop Companion Render Status Screen: Insert a new screen after waiting to explicitly confirm desktop render readiness and visual asset generation before entering home. (why: Support logs show multiple complaints about pets failing to appear on desktop or app stalling, alongside a high mean home wait duration of 2336s.)
3: [finish, new_flow] Pet Control Mode Setup Flow: Add an interaction choice component on the final screen allowing users to pick how they prefer to interact with their pet on desktop. (why: Support reported 3 emails regarding confusion over how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after completing onboarding.)
4: [home, wait_info] Pet Generation Status Progress Tips: Show progress indicators and detailed progress tips during pet generation on the waiting screen. (why: The waiting step has an extremely high mean time of 2336s, causing user drop-off due to perceived stalling.)
5: [choose_path, hint] Path Selection Mode Guidance Hint: Provide a helpful hint on path selection explaining that chosen preferences can be changed later in app settings. (why: Choose path has a high mean duration of 514s compared to a median of 8s, indicating user friction over path commitment.)
6: [home, notification] Background Processing Desktop Alert: Enable desktop notification alerts when companion rendering completes on the waiting screen. (why: With a mean waiting time of 2336s (over 38 minutes), users minimize the app and need notification when generation finishes.)
7: [sign_in, copy] Account Sync Reassurance Copy: Update sign-in headline and body copy to emphasize that signing in backs up pet data and prevents companion resets. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing back in.)
8: [choose_path, layout] Two Column Path Selection Layout: Switch the choose path screen to a two-column layout for clearer side-by-side comparison of onboarding paths. (why: Choose path mean time is 514s, showing that users spend significant time comparing long path options.)

scores.note: Adoption has highest drop-off (39.1%), but redesign tests have weak historical support.
Sign-in reordering is well-supported by 3 positive previous tests including an 8.1% win.
Strong support mail evidence, but adding new screens often slows conversion.
Addresses support complaints, but new flows on finish step have weak evidence.
High mean wait time (2336s); cheap copy/info update to reduce bounce during wait.
Addresses high mean duration (514s vs median 8s) via low-cost hint copy update.
Helps long 38-minute render wait, re-engaging users when background processing finishes.
Backed by 8 support emails; simple, low-cost copy change with low risk.
Addresses long comparison time on path step, but choose_path changes have thin evidence.
